title: CE60046: Soil Exploration
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Planning of Geotechnical exploration, methods of boring, types of samples and
sampling, non-destructive testing, field tests: standard penetration, plate
load, static and dynamic cone penetration, field vane shear and pressuremeter
tests, electrical resistivity and seismic refraction tests, location of ground
water table, processing of soil exploration data and its interpretation,
Offshore exploration.
